units: <cite ref="Berakhot 24a">Ber. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דכובע</he> the top of the cap (the bag containing the T’fillin).
<cite ref="Eruvin 76b:3">Erub. 76ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 8a:3">Succ. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דקרנאתא</he> the projection of the corners (of a square inscribed in a circle).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 3a:16">B. Bath. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דקרנתא</he> the projections of a rough stone wall.
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:5">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ קמא דכתית</he> the top of the scab, opp. <cite ref="E00212"><he>הוּדְרָנָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 100b:10">Ib. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>ודילמא מ׳ אית לה</he> Ms. M. perhaps the ground in the water has a projecting eminence (v. Tosaf. a. l.; ed. <he>והא מ׳ אית לה</he> but has not the ship a projecting point (a helm)?—

<cite ref="Chullin 17b:2">Ḥull. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ קמא וכ׳</he> the anterior edge of a notch in a knife cuts smoothly (the skin and flesh) and the posterior edge tears the vital parts (<cite ref="O00709"><he>סימנים</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Menachot 94b:3">Men. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>מורשה עביד להו</he> (Rashi <cite ref="M00674"><he>מורשא</he></cite>) he attache sto the shipshaped cake a projection.
